decisions.reason: The safety shoe line is the firm's core business, built on in-house manufacturing and development know-how, so the firm can read market feedback and refine the models.
The comfort insole complements the core footwear and draws on the firm's foot-measurement expertise, though it overlaps with the other insoles and could be consolidated.
The supportive insole rests on existing ergonomic knowledge, but its overlap with the comfort and moulded insoles leaves some risk of consolidation.
The ergonomic series combines core shoe competence with the firm's ergonomics development, giving it strong capacity to learn and improve the line.
The moulded insole is the flagship and ties together the measurement tools, training services and footwear knowledge, so it is strategically central.
